commands.command:
set -e
echo "SSID:"
networksetup -getairportnetwork en0 || true
echo "WIFI_INFO:"
networksetup -getinfo Wi-Fi || true
echo "ROUTER:"
ipconfig getoption en0 router || true
echo "EN0:"
ifconfig en0 | egrep 'status:|inet ' || true
echo "ARP_PHONE:"
arp -n 192.168.0.100 || true
echo "PING_GATEWAY:"
ping -c 1 -W 1000 192.168.0.1 || true
echo "PING_PHONE:"
ping -c 1 -W 1000 192.168.0.100 || true
